svg.title: To derive this, write Y = B0 + lRT 0 R0 and X = b0 + mF T 0 F0. The unamended defect is RT 0 V R0 and the intertwining identity is SR0 = F0T. Substitution makes the bracket RT 0 (V +lI −mSTS)R0. Since R0B = Fd2 and B is symmetric, the displayed formula follows with R = F TAF. The exterior lifts, regular symbols and analytic inverse estimates construct B0, b0, S, F with the bounds used here.
